text:
alyssa: heads-up — LangChain reached out with OrchWave (SI) to co-launch a bundled offering (LangChain connectors + OrchWave orchestration) on the cloud marketplaces (AWS/GCP) + a joint announcement. They want a launch window around 2026-05-15. Need to align product, marketplace listing, and comms.

brett: timeline noted. do we have a kickoff doc or checklist? can we push to 2-week prep cadence?

mike: re: demo — devrel can build a 10-min flow showing LlamaIndex -> Redwood Gateway -> OrchWave orchestrator. Need sample dataset + prompt set. who owns the data sample?

alyssa: i'll own partner coordination. @brett can you own marketplace packaging + listing requirements? @jordan pls own the gateway adapter readiness/compat cert. @sophia you + comms take the announcement plan and embargo. mike gets demo build.

jordan: quick note on adapter: we need an explicit compatibility matrix (model variants, tokenization, kv cache sizes) and a smoke test script. Suggest we pin to: redwood/redwood-runtime v2.1 and gateway-adapter v1.4 for launch. code snippet for smoke test runner:

```bash
# run basic end-to-end smoke test
RD_API_KEY=redacted 
python demo_runner.py --config configs/langchain_orchwave_smoke.yaml --timeout 60
```

jordan: will add perf numbers (p50/p95 latency) for the matrix and a minimal quantization profile to avoid surprises on small infra.

sophia: embargo window confirmed: 2026-05-12 to 2026-05-15. Need co-author list and one-page partner quote by 2026-05-01. Also request: 2 hero screenshots (1280x720) + 30s demo video. can partners supply logos in SVG?

brett: marketplace checklist items from my side: billing SKU, pricing tier guidance, security questionnaire (SOC2 answers), deployment diagrams, usage-based metering tags. I'll open the AWS/GCP listing drafts by EOD tomorrow.

mike: sample dataset — I'll reuse the anonymized customer-support corpus we used in Feb demo. Anyone object?

alyssa: fine with that. Mike, can you also add the prompt eval set so we can run Redwood Optimize regressions?

mike: yes, will add prompt evals.

alyssa: action items recap: 
- marketplace listing owner: brett (drafts by tom)
- gateway adapter + compat matrix: jordan (add perf + smoke test)
- demo + sample data + evals: mike (demo ready by 2026-05-06)
- comms + embargo + quotes + assets: sophia (coordinator)
- partner coordination + legal handshake: alyssa

alyssa: next check-in Thurs 09:30 PT. if anyone can't do that slot, flag here. Also linking the living plan: https://internal.redwood.com/syncs/langchain-orchwave-launch (partner has access).

oncall-bot: Reminder set: Launch coordination sync — Thu 09:30 PT — 2026-04-24 (added by alyssa). :bell:
